question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

To reveal a secret
solution:
Here, the correct answer is "Divulge."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"divulge" **means to disclose or reveal information that was previously kept private or secret. (गुप्‍त बात बताना, (रहस्‍य) प्रकट करना)
 
• It involves making something known that was previously concealed or confidential.
 
 
• **Example**: *She hesitated to **divulge**__ the details of the surprise party, wanting to keep it a secret until the last moment.*
 
 
 
• When we divulge information, we are sharing it with others, often by speaking or expressing it in some way.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Vilify: to say or write unpleasant things about somebody/something to make other people have a bad opinion of them. (अप्रिय बात लिखना या कहना; बदनाम करना; निंदा करना)
 
• Conceal: to hide something/somebody; to prevent something/somebody from being seen or discovered. ((किसी से कुछ) छिपाना; गुप्‍त रखना)
 
• Discern: to see or notice something with difficulty. (कठिनाई से किसी वस्‍तु को देख या पहचान पाना)
